title: Openness of the restricted fibre Cohen-Macaulay locus
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and U an open of T. Suppose f restricted over U is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. The set of points y of X such that f(y) lies in U and depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of the local ring of the fibre X_{f(y)} at y [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] is open in X.

source.place: Tags 045U (1), (2); depth criterion for Noetherian local rings (00N8)

proof.text: Construct the restriction fibre map using the pullback square of f restricted over U and the residue-field map of U.ι. The latter is an isomorphism, hence the fibre map is an isomorphism by isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback. Compose with the equality isomorphism identifying the base point with f(x). Its composite with the fibre inclusion equals the restricted fibre inclusion followed by the source open inclusion. Injectivity of the fibre inclusion identifies the asFiber points. The induced stalk map, composed with stalkCongr at that point equality, is a ring equivalence. Transport regular sequences through this equivalence and its inverse, preserving maximal-ideal membership and list length; the two supremum inequalities give equality of depth. Ring Krull dimension is preserved by ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv. This proves equality of the two depth-equals-dimension predicates without any Noetherian assumption.

Apply the unrestricted fibre-locus openness theorem to f restricted over U. The source open inclusion has open image on every open subset. Prove that the image of the restricted locus is the desired subset of X: a restricted point gives membership in U and the transported depth equality; conversely a point y satisfying those conditions defines the subtype point (y,hy), which belongs to the restricted locus by the inverse predicate equivalence. Rewrite by this image equality and apply the open-map property of the source inclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 045U (1), (2); restriction and regular-sequence transport proved in Lean, with unrestricted openness isolated as a new intermediate theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem isOpen_fibre_depth_eq_ringKrullDim_over_restrict
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] :
    IsOpen {y : X | f y ∈ U ∧
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))}
